semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact mana cost, Artifact type, activation costs, and rejection of unsupported cohort shapes.
A Program cannot create a delayed child without its private occurrence.
Each player's face-down exile, APNAP draws, public projection, and delayed exact return.
The tap cost is mandatory.
Copied activations create independent cohorts and delayed triggers.
The 903.9a choice occurs after all draws and can remove the commander from the cohort.
The owner's 903.9b choice precedes the return batch and ordinary names remain private.
Started draws finish for survivors; an unavailable controller has no future trigger.
A started Library of Leng discard and the exact return finish after controller departure.
A real Banishing Light Aura return suspends and restores the begun child and cohort.
An empty initial cohort still produces its delayed discard.
An unsuccessful draw and player loss do not skip surviving players' instructions.
A delayed ability created during an end step waits for the next end step.
The activation and delayed trigger are separately counterable and release their cohorts.
A departing discard chooser is removed while the surviving discard and return finish.
Source-owner and affected-player departures before and after the delayed trigger.
A later exile incarnation cannot replace the captured card.
A parked Commander return survives the controller or chooser leaving.
Serialized accepted commands reproduce event batches across a private choice and departure.
Unbegun activation, observer, and stacked trigger are removed with their controller.
A live controller resolves its borrowed activation after the physical source owner leaves.
